Acquisition / Media efficiency

Average cost per click (CPC)

The average media cost of recorded ad clicks for the selected campaign and period. Use the actual cost associated with those clicks rather than a maximum bid or an unrelated agency invoice.

Level 4Inspect the detail

The average media cost of recorded ad clicks for the selected campaign and period. Use the actual cost associated with those clicks rather than a maximum bid or an unrelated agency invoice.

currency / click

How we use it

Track the cost of bringing people into the funnel. We pair CPC with visitor quality and downstream conversion to identify which traffic sources deserve further testing.

Transparent calculationMedia cost associated with recorded clicks ÷ recorded ad clicks
click cost6,000
clicks2,400

6,000 ÷ 2,400 = 2.50 currency units per recorded click.

Illustrative calculation. Not a client result or a universal benchmark.

Break the result down

  • Campaign and bidding setup
  • Audience and placement
  • Device and market

Questions we investigate

  • Did auction or audience conditions change?
  • Are lower-cost clicks generating useful outcomes?
  • Do cost and click scopes match?

Actions the evidence supports

  • Review bidding and targeting against outcomes.
  • Compare equivalent placements and markets.
  • Connect click costs to qualified lead economics.

Reporting contract

Ownership & cadence

Paid media lead
Weekly with consistent cost attribution.

Required data

  • Click-associated media cost
  • Recorded clicks from the same scope
  • Currency, bidding, and campaign configuration

Read the measure with context

Zero clicks makes average CPC undefined. Low-cost clicks can still produce expensive customers. Mixed currencies, networks, or click types require normalization before comparison; CPC excludes sales salaries and acquisition overhead.
